data.title: 埃塔 · 雾化实验的衣物错位
data.description: 雾化重组实验刚结束，埃塔的史莱姆战服在重组时出了点小差错——衣料错位地贴在身上，半透明的史莱姆还在缓缓流动。她面无表情地低头检查，在记录板上写下：“副作用：羞耻。建议忽略。”
data.location: 阴影庭园地下实验室·实验场
data.action: 低头检查错位的半透明史莱姆衣，手持记录板，表情平淡
data.lighting: purple glow of the mist formation circle
data.promptProse: Following a midnight atomization experiment inside her underground laboratory, Eta stands inside a pulsing purple magic circle holding a clipboard and calmly examining her misaligned, semi-translucent black slime bodysuit, pleated skirt, and gartered black thighhighs. Violet luminescence from the runic floor cuts through the clinging mist around her unbothered expression.
data.nsfwProse: Her black slime bodysuit and pleated skirt have reformed half-translucent and misaligned over her torso, paired with slim garter straps and black thighhighs.
data.animaCaption: Standing calmly within a glowing purple runic mist circle holding her research clipboard, she looks down with a flat, sleepy deadpan to inspect her misaligned, half-translucent black slime bodysuit and gartered thighhighs. Faint violet radiance shines right through the misted fabric.
